name: link-text-check
title: Link Text Check
description: Link text check for Markdown or a live DOM region that flags "click here" and "read more", URLs as link text, empty links and the same text pointing to different places, with a rewrite that lifts the sentence's own words into the link and a view of the links list as read out.

meta.stops: Click here links fail screen readers
meta.summary: Flags "click here", bare URLs and empty links that make no sense to screen reader users browsing a list of links, and suggests better text.
catches: Generic text such as "click here" and "read more"
Raw URLs used as link text
Empty links, including linked images with no alt
The same text pointing to different destinations
Rewrite suggestion from the surrounding sentence
limits: English generic phrases by default; pass genericText to translate
Suggested rewrites need a human check
Doesn't check link targets or contrast
a11y: Section is labelled; summary is a polite live region
Rows focus the link in live mode; smooth scroll is skipped under reduced motion
Focus returns to a nearby fix after applying one
